top_story_title: PHP2Shell exploited to root Palo Alto Networks firewalls; Cisco confirms its own PHP-affected products
top_story_summary: SecurityWeek reports that the critical PHP flaws being referenced as PHP2Shell - CVE-2026-109618 (RCE via out-of-memory corruption) and CVE-2026-109619 (RCE via stale global state) - are being used to gain root on Palo Alto Networks firewalls, while the same attack chain fails against WordPress. The report puts over 22.6 million exposed instances in scope and says the flaws have been targeted for more than a week. Both CVEs were added to CISA's KEV catalog on 2026-10-26 with a remediation due date of 2026-10-29, which has already passed.
top_actions: Inventory internet-facing Palo Alto Networks firewalls and Cisco devices, and confirm each running version against the vendor's fixed-release table for CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619 and CVE-2026-111497 - check the vendor advisory for the fixed release, none is stated in the sources.
Remove the management plane (HTTPS/SSH/API) and any PHP-backed web interface from untrusted and internet-facing interfaces now; restrict to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network.

Treat any device that was internet-exposed in the past week as potentially pre-compromised: after upgrading, rotate local admin credentials, API keys, certificates and VPN pre-shared keys, and terminate all active sessions.
Export and diff device configurations against a known-good baseline, looking for unexpected admin users, scripts, static routes, port forwards or modified login pages.

Note that the CISA KEV due date for both PHP2Shell CVEs (2026-10-29) has passed and the Brotli CVE is due 2026-11-10; record patched / mitigated / accepted-risk against each device group in the change record.
executive_summary: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) is being used to gain root on Palo Alto Networks firewalls; both CVEs are KEV-listed with a due date of 2026-10-29 that has already passed.

CISA added two actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure flaws to KEV on 2026-10-30 - CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 - which chain with CVE-2026-104935 for unauthenticated root access on the VPN gateway; CVE-2026-111357 is due 2026-11-02.

Cisco published October advisories for both PHP2Shell and the Node.js release line, the latter including KEV-listed Brotli flaw CVE-2026-111497 (due 2026-11-10); Palo Alto Networks rates the same Brotli CVE CRITICAL across its portfolio.
No source in this window states a fixed release for any of these - confirm versions against each vendor's fixed-release table rather than assuming a build.

Cisco also issued an informational advisory on the emergency distrust of eight compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs, whose private keys can be brute-forced in seconds - a trust-store and certificate-validation task, not a patch.
Nothing in this window is genuinely AI-related; the AI section carries forward.
key_actions: **Ivanti** — Patch to the vendor's fixed build and run the Ivanti Integrity Checker Tool - check the vendor advisory for the fixed release, the source does not name one.
**Ivanti** — Terminate all active sessions and revoke session tokens after the upgrade; assume session cookies were stolen.

**Palo Alto Networks** — Confirm the running version of every Palo Alto Networks firewall against the vendor's fixed-release table and schedule the upgrade in the change window, HA pair secondary first - check the vendor advisory for the fixed release.

**Palo Alto Networks** — Remove management access (HTTPS/SSH/API) and any exposed web interface from untrusted and internet-facing interfaces; restrict to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network.
**Ivanti** — Treat the KEV due dates as your own deadlines: CVE-2026-111357 by 2026-11-02, CVE-2026-118527 by 2026-11-13.
**Ivanti** — Identify affected appliances from the asset inventory, filtered by model and running version, and record internet exposure for each as BOD 26-04 requires.

**Cisco** — Pull the affected-product list from the Cisco advisory, match it against your inventory by model and running version, and re-check the advisory periodically - Cisco states it will be updated as information becomes available.
**Cisco** — Apply the Cisco fixed release for each affected product; validate ISSU or hitless upgrade paths for core and distribution devices before touching them.

headlines.title: Attackers Chain Three Ivanti Connect Secure Flaws to Gain Unauthenticated Root Access
headlines.summary: Three chained Ivanti Connect Secure flaws give attackers unauthenticated root on the VPN gateway, with two of them added to CISA's KEV catalog after exploitation in the wild.

headlines.title: PHP2Shell Attacks Root Palo Alto Firewalls but Fail Against WordPress
headlines.summary: The PHP2Shell flaws are being exploited to gain root on Palo Alto Networks firewalls, with the same attack chain failing against WordPress targets.

headlines.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
headlines.summary: CISA added Ivanti Connect Secure flaws CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to the KEV catalog on evidence of active exploitation, with remediation deadlines in early November.

headlines.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
headlines.summary: Cisco's October advisory covers four high-severity Node.js flaws in its products, including KEV-listed Brotli decoder bug CVE-2026-111497 that risks remote code execution.

headlines.title: CVE-2026-111497 Portfolio Status: Impact of Brotli Vulnerability (CVE-2026-111497) on Palo Alto Networks Products (Severity: CRITICAL)
headlines.summary: Palo Alto Networks published a portfolio status page rating the KEV-listed Brotli flaw CVE-2026-111497 as CRITICAL for its products.

headlines.title: Vulnerabilities in PHP Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
headlines.summary: Cisco's October advisory confirms the two critical PHP2Shell remote code execution flaws affect products in its portfolio, both already KEV-listed.
